payload.summary: Disaster recovery has never been rehearsed at the data layer — only the schema replay has been tested
payload.detail: Run one real restore-to-a-new-project drill and record the wall-clock time and what was lost. Why: docs/disaster-recovery-runbook.md states plainly that only the schema layer was rehearsed (2026-07-07, ~19s local container replay) and that the platform restore plus golden retrieval eval has never been executed — so 'we have backups' is currently an untested claim on the live clinical corpus. Distinct from #1K6T35, which is the accepted ~24h recovery-point decision, not whether a restore works at all. Owner: user + operator (provider-backed). Confidence: high — the runbook says so itself. Depends on: #1K6T35 context.
payload.source: session 2026-09-20 /ledger sweep — nine-agent repo maturity review
